local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local old=world:FindFirstChild("UpgradeSigns")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="UpgradeSigns";folder.Parent=world

local upgrades={
 {title="SPEED",sub="Move Faster"},
 {title="ENERGY WORTH",sub="Orbs Give More"},
 {title="ENERGY AMOUNT",sub="More Orbs Spawn"}
}

local function makeSign(number,z,data)
 local x=-21
 local post=Instance.new("Part");post.Name="Upgrade"..number.."Post";post.Size=Vector3.new(1,5,1);post.Position=Vector3.new(x,22.5,z);post.Anchored=true;post.Color=Color3.fromRGB(93,66,43);post.Material=Enum.Material.Wood;post.Parent=folder
 local board=Instance.new("Part");board.Name="Upgrade"..number.."Sign";board.Size=Vector3.new(.7,5,9);board.Position=Vector3.new(x,26,z);board.Anchored=true;board.Color=Color3.fromRGB(48,54,66);board.Material=Enum.Material.Slate;board.Parent=folder
 local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui");gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Right;gui.Parent=board
 local text=Instance.new("TextLabel");text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);text.BackgroundTransparency=1;text.Text=data.title.."\n"..data.sub;text.TextWrapped=true;text.TextScaled=true;text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,230,120);text.Parent=gui
end

makeSign(1,-11,upgrades[1])
makeSign(2,0,upgrades[2])
makeSign(3,11,upgrades[3])
print("Named upgrade signs loaded")
